newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain plans to set up $26.5 mln training centre.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain plans to set up $26.5 mln training centre.

text.p: Bahrain plans to set up a 10 million dinar ($26.5 million) job training centre in an effort to promote the Gulf state as a regional training base and find more work for Bahrainis.

Local newspapers on Tuesday quoted Labour and Social Affairs Minister Abdel-Nabi al-Shula as saying that Mohammed Salahuddin Consulting Engineering Bureau had been appointed consultant to the new government project in Isa Town.
"The new complex will feature state-of-the-art designs, and it is aimed at meeting our future training needs and human resource development strategy," Shula said.

Bahrain, with a population of around 580,000, has embarked on a drive to find more jobs for its citizens to combat rising unemployment which has helped fuel anti-government unrest that started in December 1994.
